WHO WE ARE
Pakistan's Engineering Partner for Complex Projects

Azaan Trading & Contracting (ATC) is a multi-division engineering and contracting company delivering high-specification projects across civil infrastructure, electrical & power, mechanical systems, oil & gas, defense infrastructure, and smart building technology. Our teams operate across Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, bringing global engineering standards to every project.
